name: anthropics/ralph-wiggum — Official Anthropic Loop Plugin; 139K Stars; Day 4; Stop Hook Keeps Claude Working Until Done
hook: Ralph Wiggum is the official Anthropic autonomous-loop plugin inside the claude-code repo: a Stop hook blocks Claude's exit, re-injects the original prompt, and loops until Claude outputs a configurable completion phrase (e.g., `<promise>COMPLETE</promise>`) or hits `--max-iterations`. Concrete benefit: you can hand it a greenfield REST API spec and walk away — Claude reads its own git history and file output each iteration to improve, catches its own test failures, and only stops when done. 139K stars, 22.3K forks.
